description: Billing (Polar). action='upgrade' does NOT create a checkout — it returns the dashboard URL where the user picks a paid plan (starter | maker | max), a monthly or yearly term, and confirms the immediate-start request the law requires. Surface that URL; Percher never changes a subscription server-side. action='portal' returns the customer-portal URL for managing an existing subscription (cancel, update card, invoices); url is null for users who never subscribed, in which case suggest action='upgrade'.
name: percher_billing
